notes.title: 40000 wishlists!
notes.content: [p][b]Silicone Heart[/b] — a mini-progress update ❤️[/p][p]While we're preparing playtests and polishing the demo, we've received a pleasant surprise: [b]+1,500[/b] wishlists in the last few days![/p][p]We've surpassed [b]40,000[/b] and are confidently heading toward a beautiful [b]50,000[/b].[/p][p]Thanks to everyone who's been with us — your wishlist additions really help the game's visibility and speed up the release.[/p][p]Playtesting is coming soon. Stay tuned here and on the Steam page![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45308779/66db024ab43beb2ab1c8afeff968a8e681f81249.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: The Outcast Settlement
notes.content: [p][b]Friends![/b] We continue our journey through the world of [i]Silicone Heart[/i], uncovering its secrets.[/p][p align="start"]In [i]Silicone Heart[/i], a major city has its "shadow" — an enclave for those not accepted as their own. Here live the [i]obsolete robots[/i], who failed to integrate into the system and carved out their own outpost.[/p][p align="start"]We’ve developed [b]three conceptual variations[/b]:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45308779/823718a6c9088fb4db9bb45087bdba9680e51997.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45308779/4432a90eb6cafe6e12aebec83cc6e95c90cca1d0.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45308779/33c4aa052be0fb62b951793377ef9deff51a379c.png"][/img][/p][p]Which one is closer to your vision? [b]Write in the comments)[/b][/p]

notes.title: Our Rock Band
notes.content:
[p]We did it! The [b]band is finally ready.[/b] It was a tough road — sweat, nerves, and countless fixes — but now they’re here to meet you in [b]Silicone Heart[/b].[/p][p]What will they play first? Well… let’s keep that a little secret for now One thing’s for sure — their concert will be waiting for every wanderer brave enough to land on our scrapyard planet.

notes.title: 35,000 wishlists — and counting
notes.content: [p]We’ve officially hit [b]35,000[/b] wishlists for Silicone Heart on Steam![/p][p]That’s 35,000 people waiting to jump in and see what we’ve been building. For a small team, this is an insane boost of motivation to keep going and give it our all. [/p][p][b]Huge thanks[/b] to everyone who wishlisted the game, left a comment, dropped a like, or simply follows our journey. You’re the real [b]MVPs[/b].[/p][p][/p][p] Now tell us — who’s going to be there on day one?[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45308779/ebf42b2e98861125e2b9a06d5fe520ecc2f9b56b.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Resource Gathering
notes.content: [p]Second week in a row, the Silicone Heart team has been fine-tuning the core mechanics of resource gathering. Right now, they’re laser-focused on chopping trees — making sure the animations are satisfying, the fall feels weighty, the sound effects are realistic, and the flying wood bits look just right. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45308779/64adc6212788021f5bd4f3ac32528d0d764644ad.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45308779/8c694012eeae7d4d5efceebc754c52e1e8e68d36.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]In many similar games, clearing land and gathering materials becomes one of the most oddly satisfying parts of gameplay.  That’s exactly the feeling the team is aiming to deliver here — a routine that feels good every single time. [/p][p][b]What do you think of the current state? What would you improve or add?[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]We’ve got one small favor to ask[/b]: If you like what we’re doing — tell your friends! The demo will support 4-player co-op, so bring your crew aboard!   [/p][p]And don’t forget to [b]wishlist[/b] the game — it helps a ton and brings us closer to our big dream: [b]100,000 wishlists[/b] [/p]

notes.title: First build of Silicone Heart
notes.content:
[p][b]Hey everyone![/b] We're back with another update on the development of Silicone Heart. [/p][p]Today’s a big milestone — [b]we’ve got our first working build of the game![/b][/p][p] And it already has a bunch of features and gameplay available! Are you ready to watch?
[/p][previewyoutube="YQIgYUYW9qY;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Let's look at all the mechanics we've already done in more detail:[/p][p]— A full introduction with cutscenes, jokes and tasks.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45308779/8a9560093329761001cbb3585a6ef15e215e6364.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]— Transformation of our assistant into a super exoskeleton.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45308779/0cd93d1e4d0371679003c8e9404f68cb2cee72c6.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]— Crafting system through inventory and workbench.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45308779/d67684a6bc72634a7bcfff423b0559e959b5454b.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]— A whole bunch of industrial buildings.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45308779/978c2fdd7d1ded134697cd7f37e300294de33e71.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45308779/e863238b5f6fade9f9567c5514ad5ce13639a3d8.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]— Electricity and water supply system.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45308779/3541c29185101ac6c0691b42ceb8f1d987c965aa.png"][/img][/p][p]— Alternation of day and night and sleeping in a bed.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45308779/ab4fa4408ca08727a1aa1933664d8d72d1cf0154.png"][/img][/p][p]We were in a hurry, because we had an opportunity to attract a strong partner to Silicone Heart. And for this we needed a build. In the end, everything was done on time. The build was sent. [/p][p][/p][p][b]How do you like it? — Write your opinion in the discussions.[/b][/p][p][b]And make sure to add the game to your wishlist — it means a lot to us![/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: The Road to Playtest
notes.content:
[p][b]Hey everyone![/b] Summer’s in full swing — and you know what that means… the demo is creeping closer! [/p][p]To make the closed playtest happen, we’ve still got a ton of work ahead. But trust us — we’re beyond excited to show you what we’ve been cooking up.[/p][p]As you probably know, our hero is just your average space garbage collector, cruising the stars in a rusty old trash hauler. And speaking of which... behold the garbage truck of the future: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45308779/2beee93be8dd67be152386ff5c19d623e994c99d.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Life aboard the hauler isn’t exactly peaceful. Case in point: even the robot vacuum has declared war on our slippers:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45308779/5762d4788a230c2b28892f0ae22b99cc2453fa2c.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Oh, and after a rather explosive incident, our guy somehow managed to survive. We've already animated the exact spot where his ship went down — in all its fiery glory.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45308779/64b2c2a84055071365e4478a4ef750e28248b487.gif"][/img][/p][p]Let’s talk gameplay. The core loop? Grow weird alien plants — after you fix up a bunch of broken robots. We’ve sketched out the first batch of plants your character will cultivate and trade for energy. Each plant gets its own fancy icon, and there’s a lot more coming![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45308779/b123f13ff75832b26f8b564901d410bd01318c78.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We’re also deep into cutscenes — essential for tone and story. Here’s a sneak peek at one early draft showing the transformation of our whiskered protagonist (and his robotic buddy):[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45308779/e5d6b78cc4cae974d69b41061f037aa5e2d5e921.png"][/img][/p][p][b]We’ve got one small favor to ask[/b]: If you like what we’re doing — tell your friends! The demo will support 4-player co-op, so bring your crew aboard! 

And don’t forget to [b]wishlist[/b] the game — it helps a ton and brings us closer to our big dream: [b]100,000 wishlists[/b] 

Should we keep posting devlogs like this? [/p][p]Let us know what you want to see in the game — we’re reading every comment.[/p]

notes.title: 🎬 SILICONE HEART TRAILER — WATCH NOW! 🎬
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We’re excited to share a big announcement — [b]the Silicone Heart trailer is out now![/b]

The main character is an outcast, thrown onto the scrap heap of history. After a tragic accident, a junkman ends up on a garbage planet inhabited by discarded robots. He’ll have to hide his identity and build his way to survival using whatever trash he can find.

[list]
[b]What to expect:[/b]
[*] Tons of scrap waiting to be turned into something useful.
[*] Become a farmer and grow strange, otherworldly plants.
[*] Repair local robots and earn back their trust in humans.
[/list]

[b]And that’s just the beginning — even more surprises await.[/b]
🚀 Demo coming this summer.
🔥 Kickstarter campaign launching soon!

[b]Watch and share your thoughts![/b]
👇 [previewyoutube=sxmViprV-xg;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Drop a comment: [/b]
➜ Which game mechanic caught your eye?
➜ What role do you think the mysterious substance will play?
➜ Do you believe the hero will complete his mission?
